name: fuse-toast
title: FuseToast
description: feedback: Undo toast whose time runs out as a fuse burning along its edge; it pauses while hovered or focused (canvas 2D, server-safe toast)

item.name: fuse-toast
item.summary: feedback: Undo toast whose time runs out as a fuse burning along its edge; it pauses while hovered or focused (canvas 2D, server-safe toast)

useWhen: Undo after a reversible action (archive, delete to trash, move)
A single, important confirmation that commits after a few seconds
avoidWhen: Errors or messages that must not disappear on their own
Several toasts stacked at once (one fuse at a time reads best)

tiers.0: The control alone (server render, reduced motion, Save-Data, no WebGL2): no canvas
tiers.2: Effect on a canvas at DPR <= 1.5 with half the particles
tiers.3: Effect on a canvas at DPR <= 2 with the full particle count

reducedMotion.description: The toast works and times out the same; the fuse is a plain line with no flame, sparks or canvas.

input.pointer: The action button; the fuse stops while the pointer is over the toast
input.keyboard: The action is a native button; the fuse stops while focus is inside the toast

a11y.notes: The toast sits in a role=status live region, so its message is announced. The time limit stops while the pointer is over it or focus is inside it (WCAG 2.2.1), and `duration` sets its length. The fuse canvas is aria-hidden.

props.name: open
props.effect: Required. Shows the toast; a fresh fuse starts each time it opens.

props.name: actionLabel
props.effect: The action offered while the fuse burns.

props.name: onAction
props.effect: The action was pressed before the fuse burnt out.

props.name: onExpire
props.effect: The fuse burnt out: commit the action.

props.name: expiredMessage
props.effect: Shown for 1.2 s after the fuse burns out.

props.name: onClose
props.effect: The toast should close (after the action, or after the expired message).

props.name: duration
props.effect: Fuse length in ms (paused while hovered or focused).

props.name: palette
props.effect: Colours of the effect (DESIGN.md A8). custom reads --fb-heat-0..4 from the page.

props.name: paused
props.effect: Universal pause prop: the effect stops drawing; the control keeps working.

props.name: maxTier
props.effect: Hard ceiling on the capability tier.

props.name: nonce
props.effect: CSP nonce for the component's <style> element.

props.name: style
props.effect: Inline styles on the root, merged after the palette variables.

mistakes: Commit the action in onExpire, not when the toast opens: Undo must really undo.
Close it from onClose (set open to false); the toast does not unmount itself.
Do not use it for errors: it disappears on its own.
verify: The action button calls onAction and onClose, and onExpire never fires.
Hovering or focusing the toast stops the fuse.
